title: About your check-ins
body: Check-ins are short daily surveys sent by text. They ask how you're feeling, how the dose felt, and whether you noticed any side effects.
Your answers are what your care team uses to adjust your dose, so try to complete them even on days when nothing much has changed.
After the first several weeks, most patients move from daily to weekly check-ins. You can also ask to change how often you hear from us.
